name: Issue 5695: a level 7 Runemaster casts Palm Sigil: Fire only inside Runeshroud
contract: The report: at level 7 Palm Sigil: Fire 534803 answers 'You can't do that yet' and seems to work only in
stealth. 534803 (BaseLevel 4) has CasterAuraSpell 808089 'Runeshroud or Waveforged', the marker
SyncRuneshroudOrWaveforged keeps on the player while Runeshroud 500288 (MOD_STEALTH, BaseLevel 4) is active, and
its damage spell 807012 reads 'Requires Runeshroud'. A missing caster aura fails with
SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE (22), which the client shows as 'You can't do that yet'. Expected at level 7: the
cast is refused with 22 outside Runeshroud and completes inside it.

steps.label: SETUP: no Palm Sigil gate at rest
CONTRACT: outside Runeshroud the cast fails with 'You can't do that yet'
SETUP: Runeshroud opens the Palm Sigil gate
CONTRACT: inside Runeshroud Palm Sigil: Fire completes at level 7
